surfaces.part: glass shards and debris scattered on ground

The column scans show alternating dark, light and rust-colored pixels that are shards and a scrap seen from above, not a vertical front face. The width profile varies irregularly (8, 14, 13, 15, 16, 10, 6) and there is no distinct top band over a face. It reads as a flat floor decal seen from above, which matches the kind 'flat'.

This is not comparable to the references' multi-tone surface and fails the ground-patch requirement.
